defaults.promise: protect rare cards without looking childish
defaults.style_notes: product silhouette, material detail, logo placement

character.label: Character / host
character.note: Optional unless the ad uses a person or recurring host

voice.label: Voice
voice.note: Optional for silent drafts; ready for VO handoff when set

hooks.label: Problem
hooks.line: {audience} keep settling for gear that does not fit the job.

hooks.label: Product Reveal
hooks.line: {product} makes the upgrade obvious in the first three seconds.

scenes.label: Hook Frame
scenes.prompt: Fast clean opener for {audience}: frame the problem before revealing {product}.

scenes.label: Product Lock
scenes.prompt: Hero product frame of {product}. Preserve shape, materials, logo placement, and scale.

scenes.label: Use Moment
scenes.prompt: Show {product} in a realistic use moment for {audience}; no extra text artifacts.
scenes.voiceover: The useful part is visible, not explained.

scenes.label: Offer Close
scenes.prompt: Resolve into a clean final lockup for {offer}. Keep negative space for captions and CTA.

handoff.image_prompt: {product} hero frame for {audience}. {promise}. Clean brand-safe composition, no unreadable text.
handoff.video_prompt: {product} campaign for {audience}. Open with: {hook0}. Show {offer}. Resolve with a clear product lock and CTA.

image.notes: Campaign hero/start frame from the Production stack

reasons.image_no_ref: No product reference set; image handoff will start from text and may drift.
reasons.video_no_ref: Seedance video handoff requires a product reference/start frame.
reasons.video_aspect: Seedance renders 16:9 or 9:16; {aspect} is sent as {sent} and cropped in post.
reasons.voice_no_script: Voice handoff requires a generated script.
reasons.image_aspect: {aspect} is not a native image ratio; the hero frame is generated at {sent}.

handoff.source_frame_read_ok: the product reference image defines product identity, shape, materials, and scale
handoff.source_frame_read_missing: start frame required before video generation; use image handoff to create one first

checklist: Start frame identity is readable before motion begins
No synthetic text appears unless supplied as a reference
Subject stays inside the central safe area
End frame resolves cleanly for crop and captions
director.primary_action: {subject} holds a single coherent hero action while the camera performs {movement}
director.motion_budget: one readable motion idea; avoid chaotic secondary movement
director.lighting_lock: stable motivated light with no flicker or exposure pumping

segments.forbidden_zone: no immediate morphing, crop loss, or text artifacts
no secondary chaos, duplicate objects, or warped identity

segments.action: hold a clean exportable end frame
segments.forbidden_zone: no late new props, no logo smearing, no exposure pump
